_meta.description: Application method → tool mapping. Each method lists tools needed, with image and video placeholders for the UI.
_meta.note: image_url and video_url are placeholders — user will provide actual URLs later.

basal_application.description: Mixing fertilizer into soil before sowing or transplanting
basal_application.when_to_use: Before planting — apply during land preparation

tools.name: Garden Hoe / Khurpi
tools.description: Hand tool for mixing fertilizer into topsoil in small plots

tools.name: Cultivator
tools.description: Tractor-drawn or manual cultivator to incorporate fertilizer into soil

tools.name: Seed-cum-Fertilizer Drill
tools.description: Places seed and fertilizer simultaneously in furrows

manual_spread.description: Evenly scattering granular fertilizer over the field surface
manual_spread.when_to_use: For organic manures (FYM, compost) or granular fertilizers over large areas

tools.name: Hand Broadcast Spreader
tools.description: Crank-operated spreader for even distribution of granular fertilizer

tools.name: Fertilizer Basket / Tokri
tools.description: Traditional woven basket for manual scattering of FYM, compost, or granules

tools.name: Wheelbarrow
tools.description: For transporting and dumping organic manure across the field

top_dressing.description: Applying fertilizer near the base of growing plants during crop season
top_dressing.when_to_use: During vegetative or active growth stages — apply near plant base and irrigate

tools.name: Hand Fertilizer Duster
tools.description: Small applicator for placing granular fertilizer near plant rows

tools.name: Khurpi / Hand Weeder
tools.description: Used to make shallow furrows near plants, place fertilizer, and cover

tools.name: Ring Applicator
tools.description: Circular applicator for placing fertilizer in a ring around tree crops

soil_incorporation.description: Mixing organic manure or fertilizer deeply into the soil
soil_incorporation.when_to_use: For slow-release organic fertilizers — work into soil 2-4 weeks before planting

tools.name: Spade / Phawda
tools.description: For digging in manure and compost into garden beds

tools.name: Rotavator / Rotary Tiller
tools.description: Power tiller attachment that mixes manure uniformly into topsoil

tools.name: Plough (MB / Desi)
tools.description: Traditional or mould-board plough for turning soil with organic matter

foliar_spray.description: Spraying diluted liquid fertilizer directly on leaves for quick absorption
foliar_spray.when_to_use: For micronutrient deficiencies, critical growth stages, or when soil application is insufficient

tools.name: Knapsack Sprayer (16L)
tools.description: Manual pump sprayer worn on back — most common for small-medium farms

tools.name: Battery-Operated Sprayer
tools.description: Electric pump sprayer for consistent pressure — reduces manual effort

tools.name: Measuring Cup / Beaker
tools.description: For precise dilution of concentrated liquid fertilizers

fertigation.description: Injecting water-soluble fertilizer through drip or sprinkler irrigation systems
fertigation.when_to_use: For farms with drip/sprinkler — most efficient method, reduces wastage

tools.name: Venturi Fertilizer Injector
tools.description: Low-cost device that uses water pressure to suck fertilizer solution into drip lines

tools.name: Fertilizer Mixing Tank
tools.description: Tank for dissolving and mixing water-soluble fertilizer before injection

tools.name: Fertigation Dosing Pump
tools.description: Electric or hydraulic pump for precise fertilizer injection into irrigation
